_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Giugador Biscia in sü una griglia {width}×{height}.
Te controllat la biscia {player_id}. Mòse vàlide: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (o w/s/a/d).
Obietiv: sopravivì püsé a lùng o vess la püsé lunga e ciapà el püsé alt puntegg (lìmit de mòse {max_turns}).

game_action.invalid_death: Snake {player_id} l'è mòrt per via de una mossa invalida.

outcome.survived_win: Al giugador {player_id} al è survivìt; tüti i àter a hinn mòrt.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Tüt i serpent hinn mort insemma.
outcome.outlived: El giugador l'ha vivüü de tutt i alter.
outcome.turn_limit: L'è rivà el limit de gir - la migliore scor vinc l'tie-break.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Grupp de classifega finai (del pez al mej): {groups}
